role: Forms, updates, and checks PropertyExpectation records using Welford online algorithm; compares embeddings against active expectations and applies asymmetric confidence updates.
detail: ExpectationManager class manages the full Epic 4 expectation pipeline. form_expectations() scans instance nodes for a schema type, computes centroid and variance via Welford online algorithm, and persists a PropertyExpectation (activated when sample_count >= 5 AND session_count >= 2). update_expectations() incorporates new embeddings via Welford update, rejecting outliers beyond sigma_threshold (default 2.0 from PREDICTION_ERROR_DEMOTION rule). check_prediction_error() compares embeddings against active expectations: contradictions (sigma > threshold) apply beta demotion formula (new_conf = max(floor, old * (1 - beta))); confirmations apply alpha boost formula (new_conf = min(ceiling, old + alpha * (ceiling - old))). Pure math helpers: _cosine_similarity(), _welford_update_centroid(), _welford_update_variance(), _build_initial_centroid(), _build_initial_variance(). All parameters (sigma_threshold=2.0, alpha=0.03, beta=0.15, ceiling=0.95, floor=0.10) read from graph rule node on first use and cached. No LLM calls; all operations on graph data and arithmetic. Welford method enables long-running systems without catastrophic cancellation.
gotchas: Configuration loaded lazily on first _ensure_config() call and cached per D-TS-09; backend must expose query_edges (duck-type hasattr check, not Protocol-required); session counting reads live from graph each time (not cached, A.10 compliant); PropertyExpectation is frozen dataclass so updates create new instances; cosine_distance and sigma_distance computed on-demand (variance=0 case handled); empty embeddings list returns cosine_similarity 0.0 to avoid division by zero.
